units: 1 stud = 1 Blender unit. Sizes and offsets are in studs; set each MeshPart's Size from 'size'.
axes: Roblox axes (Y up). Blender (x, y, z) -> Roblox (x, z, -y); an asset's front (Blender -Y) faces Roblox +Z. The asset origin is the bottom centre of its footprint: a piece's MeshPart sits at origin CFrame * CFrame.new(offset); VFX positions are relative to the same origin.

palette.uv: row i, level j: u = (j + 0.5) / columns, v = 1 - (i + 0.5) * cell / height (v up from the bottom of the image); a row's spare cells repeat its last level

water.uv: Water pieces carry their own UVs (not palette cells): a box projection in studs from the asset origin, one texture tile per tile_studs. Up-facing faces: u = X / tile, v = Z / tile (mod 1, Roblox axes); faces toward +-Z use (X, -Y), toward +-X use (-Z, -Y). Set MeshPart.TextureID to the uploaded texture (it wraps), Transparency from the piece, Material SmoothPlastic, CastShadow false. Assets placed on a tile_studs grid continue the pattern seamlessly.
water.flow: Pieces of an asset with a water_flow socket carry flow = {direction (unit, Roblox X/Z), speed (studs/s), socket}. To animate, use a Texture (Face Top, StudsPerTileU/V = tile_studs) on the piece instead of TextureID and move OffsetStudsU/V along direction * speed each frame.

assets.name: StreambedBankRocks
assets.subject: StreambedPatch
assets.notes: Kit-bash bank boulder cluster in its hero position (left bank, middle): one big chunky flat-topped w03_rock anchor (~6 wide, top at z ~4.4) straddling the waterline with a ~3.7-wide partner and a small chunk against it; the faces of the bases under the water (z < 1.0) are w03_riverbed. The hero places six such clusters (three per bank); one cluster per part keeps the convex hull tight to the rocks so it never blocks the stream.

assets.name: StreambedBedSlab
assets.subject: StreambedPatch
assets.notes: ground slab: w03_sand banks at z=1.6 sloping to the waterline (z=1.0), w03_riverbed below it (underwater slope, bed at 0.2, groups of low bed stones), bank pebbles; flat sand side walls on the banks, riverbed walls across the channel; walkable

assets.name: StreambedBend
assets.subject: StreambedPatch
assets.notes: Bend (Smooth Curve): quarter-circle channel (radius 16 about the front-right corner) between the right edge (y -6..6) and the front edge (x -6..6), flowing right -> front; big boulders on the outer bank, a sandbar on the inner bank. VFX: water_flow beams VFX_StreambedFlowStrips_1..3 lie on the water (z 1.03) along the centreline, start upstream -> end downstream (these ARE the reference's 'Flow Strips (Simple Mesh)': water is VFX, so no strip mesh); water_foam: 11 at rocks that break the surface or straddle a waterline (VFX_StreambedRockFoam_N), 2 riffles downstream of in-stream rocks (VFX_StreambedRiffle_N), 1 along the waterlines every ~8 studs (VFX_StreambedShoreFoam_N). No foam/ripple geometry.
